decision: Base car = 'Full Car.stl' (1Ex6611D..., 19,540,297 tris, hardtop on), decimated 3 mm / 2 mm out of core

decision: Own levelling tool (tools/level.py): ground = plane through the 4 tyre contact patches, long axis -> Y; one rigid transform (level.json) applied to every scan, then ive prep --like car
why: The 2023 export has no ground plane, so huracan-evo/tools/level.py's RANSAC ground fit has nothing to lock to; contact-patch spread after levelling 2.7 mm

decision: Logo = IllumaestheticLogo_V2COMPLETE_1.png from illumaesthetic.com/cdn/shop/files (homepage is behind a Cloudflare challenge)

decision: Registration (tools/fit.py, points within 30 mm of the car): Full Car Top Down 1.15 mm, Hardtop Mounting Full Car 1.17, Rear End trunk open 1.45, Rear QuarterPanel 1.54, Hood Duct Data 2.02, Trunk Open Cover On 2.37 / Rear Interior Trim Removed 4.5 (vs the roof-down car) -> all used at identity in the car frame
why: Same Artec frame: medians at the 3 mm decimation noise floor; my ICP on Rear End made it worse (9 mm), so no corrections

decision: 2022 'Front Bumper Data' scans (front fully removed, hood open/closed no bumper), Hood Open (Tab Ref) and FrontEnd.stl NOT used
why: Own frame (3-5% of points near the car, 15 mm median at identity); numpy global search (tools/globalreg.py) gave fit 8-10% with a different pose per candidate - not a registration. Hood Duct Data (2023-06, registered) shows the same state: hood open + front bumper off

decision: Parts derived by differencing registered scans (tools/diffpart.py): hardtop = Full Car - Full Car Top Down (450k tris, 1 component); front bumper + hood = Full Car - Hood Duct Data (split into components, front wheels masked); rear lid = Top Down - Rear End trunk open in the lid zone
why: No separate panel scans exist in the registered sessions; a difference of two same-frame state scans is the panel exactly as scanned on the car, registered by construction

decision: Hinges fitted to the captured open states (tools/hinge.py): rear lid -> Rear End trunk open, hood -> Hood Duct Data
why: Huracan lesson: fitting the hinge to the real open capture makes the opening physically right instead of a guessed pivot

decision: Exploded-view base = Full Car Top Down (roof down) trimmed of hardtop/hood/front bumper/rear lid + Hood Duct Data (front, 544k tris) and Rear End trunk open (rear, 438k tris) as captured where the panels hid structure; state points near each panel's fitted open pose dropped (tools/composite.py)
why: Roofline filter alone left the state scans' propped-open hood/lid as flaps near the hinge (seen in the s6/s7 framing test); assembled = base + 4 parts at home = the hardtop car

decision: Shot plan (Temerario order): s1 side track, s2 front 3/4 turntable, s3 rear 3/4, s4 front wheel close-up, s5 rear lamp close-up, s6 hardtop lifts off (roof-down vs hardtop beat), s7 bumper slides + hood/lid open on hinges, s8 top-down spin, s9 explode (panels stack above), s10 float, s11 reassemble to the hardtop car, logo; rendered 0.3-0.5 s longer than their slots to trim to the music
why: Brief's order; music not yet received so durations are ~100 BPM bar multiples and get trimmed to the track's accents in assembly

decision: Framing fixes after 25 % tests: s7 camera lower/forward so the sliding bumper stays in frame, s9/s10 pulled in/out, exploded stack spread vertically (top 1.6 m, hood 1.15, lid 1.05, bumper 0.8)
why: Tests showed the bumper exiting the bottom of frame, s10 cropping the bumper at the left edge, panels edge-on

decision: Music = parent session's generated MR2 track (90s city-pop, 40.05 s file); grid anchored on kick peaks: beat n = -0.0591 + 0.5357 n (112.0 BPM, 8 ms rms); bar downbeats on table beats 1+4k
why: Lesson: anchor on kick peaks not spectral onsets (ive beats onsets sit ~30 ms later). Brief: cut on this track's accents, no other music

decision: Music end measured: final hit at 33.690 s, ring-out to -30 dB at 38.81 s (-45 dB at 40.04); reel ends at 38.80 s
why: Generated tracks can end early; the last real hit is 33.69 s, so the logo lands on it and holds through the decay instead of running into silence

decision: Cuts on bar downbeats with varied holds (1-2 bars): 3.155 / 7.441 / 9.584 / 11.726 / 13.869 / 18.155 / 22.440 / 24.583 / 28.869 / 31.012 / logo 33.690; rear 3/4 starts on the big hit at 7.44 s, the exploded view separates on the second big hit 24.58 s, reassembly locks on the final hit
why: Per-beat kick/flux/RMS table (tools/music_grid.py): the loudest accents are beats at 7.44, 24.58 and 33.69 s; holds vary per lesson (reviewer wants 'a little longer/shorter', not a rigid grid)

decision: Logo card: website logo 860 px wide on render-black (projects/ferrari-296/tools/logo_card.py), 0.4 s fade-up, hard cut on 33.69 s, 5.1 s through the ring-out

decision: s7_open, s9_explode, s11_reassemble render with persistent data off; dark frames s7 34-68 and s9 46-68 deleted and re-rendered

decision: Delivered v1 (38.77 s); review.md scored
